text:
sam: alert from perf dash — inference-pool eu-west-2 p99 jumped ~120ms -> ~420ms around 00:20 UTC, steady since. SLOs tripping. anyone oncall?
irene: oncall here, I'm seeing packet-loss spikes on node-group gpu-eu-west-2a, dropped pkts ~1.8% on host NICs around the same time.
infra-bot: incident created: #1914012345, linked to infra/monitoring. CPU and GPU utilization normal, network anomalies flagged.
mike: interesting — did we push any infra changes last night? I see a config rollout to fleet-shapers at 00:15 by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: rollout: team=eng-infra change_id=shaper-shadow-2026-03. Deployed to 40% hosts in eu-west-2 at 00:14 UTC. config: default qdisc=fq_codel, ingress policing=100mbit, mtu left unchanged.
olivia: can you paste tc/qdisc on an affected host? I suspect MTU fragmentation or a misapplied ingress police.
irene: grabbing one host now — host ip 10.12.45.98 (gpu-eu-west-2a-7).
irene: ``
$ ssh root@10.12.45.98 ip link show ens6
3: ens6: mtu 1500 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
``

nirene: ``
$ tc qdisc show dev ens6
qdisc fq_codel 1: root refcnt 2 limit 10240 flows 1024 quantum 1514 target 5ms interval 100ms ecn
qdisc ingress ffff: dev ens6 parent ffff:fff1 fh 0000: cannot open filter
``

irene: kernel logs show lots of "IPV6: NDP: stale neighbor" and "fragmented packet dropped" entries.
mike: fragmented packet dropped + fq_codel + mtu 1500... are we sending jumbo from host-to-host for RDMA? RDMA expects 9000 on the fabric, right?
olivia: yes, our RDMA overlay uses 9000 in most racks. If a host reverted to 1500 or path MTU blackholed fragments, we'd see fallback to TCP and higher latency.
sam: which hosts still have 9000? can we check MTU consistency across the rack?
irene: quick grep across nodes: 10/12 hosts report mtu 1500, 2 report 9000. The rollout touched those 10 hosts (shaper-shadow) — seems like the shaper agent also reapplied a default MTU on interface bringup.
mike: oh no — the shaper agent runs a systemd unit that does `ip link set mtu 1500` if no mtu configured in profile. The rollout replaced our custom profile with one missing the mtu line.
olivia: that explains fragmentation logs. RDMA paths broke and packets got fragmented, then fq_codel started dropping small flows under congestion — inference tail sensitive.
sam: mitigation options? revert the rollout, or override mtu immediately on affected hosts.
irene: I pushed a quick fix: ``ssh root@10.12.45.98 'ip link set dev ens6 mtu 9000 && systemctl restart shaper-agent'``. Doing that across remaining affected hosts via ad-hoc parallel ssh now.
mike: also suggest we remove ingress police for now on those hosts to avoid additional drops while fabric stabilizes: ``tc qdisc del dev ens6 ingress`` — can one of you run that?
olivia: running ingress delete on the rack now.
infra-bot: change recorded: manual remediation mtu=9000 applied to 10 hosts, ingress qdisc removed on 3 top-of-rack hosts.
sam: monitoring — p99 dropping back?
irene: partial improvement: p99 down to ~210ms after MTU fix on first batch, still climbing on a few nodes where restart didn't propagate.
mike: will coordinate a full rollback of the shaper-shadow change and a follow-up PR to ensure mtu is part of the profile. Also adding a preflight that checks MTU parity vs RDMA fabric and rejects profile without mtu.
olivia: filing a config audit ticket for all regions — how widespread is this agent config?
sam: assign to infra-config.critical and send to oncall list. Also add a temporary alert that compares node MTU vs rack fabric and fires before SLOs.
irene: logs show retransmits and some TCP stalls during the window — likely caused the SLO blips. I'll annotate the incident timeline with these artifacts.
mike: note for postmortem: rollout/automation should never implicitly change packetization for RDMA hosts. Need guards and a canary sized for network-sensitive hosts.
sam: thanks everyone — keep updates here. if remediation finishes, we'll close the incident. :thumbsup:
